closure.scope: Authenticated selected unit and observed cgroup cohort only. The audited fork/setsid/empty-env case is covered; explicit delegated cgroup migration or user-manager requests are not prevented.

gpu_identity_baseline.scope: NVML-backed read-only identity and Linux memory read; no CUDA/Torch import, model access, allocator/context, process/service mutation or host reserve admission.

successful_parent_postlaunch_host_gate_s.scope: All successful executed post-launch readiness/preexec/loop host-gate samples, including discarded raw samples; failing gates stay in primary evidence; initial/final separate; not a continuous-time minimum

actor_receipt.limits: Context and tiny BF16 fill/matmul only; no model/header/payload/mmap,UMA physical cap,12B,8192,20s,N3/Q95 or benchmark qualification.

own_allocator_cap.scope: Own PyTorch caching allocator only. Not a context/driver/cuBLAS/physical UMA or cgroup hard cap. Never enlarged on failure.

tiny_operator.scope: Tiny fill/matmul and512B CPU readback only; no model transfer, layer, accuracy or throughput qualification.

gpu_context_probe_scope: Own pinned-GPU CUDA context and16x16 BF16 kernel only;no model/blob/full12B/8192context/20s/N3/Q95/browser-quality claim;2GiB unit memcg is not a shared-GPU-pages hard cap
